profile.about:
I'm a software engineer from Rajkot, India, and I build complete systems rather than isolated pieces. Most days that means C# and .NET on the backend, Angular or Blazor on the front end, and the database design that holds both together.

My professional work has been on client products at Sky9 IT Craft. An aircraft ownership and flight-record platform. An enterprise mailing system used by US mailing organizations. A waste-management admin platform for a UK company. That work taught me what production actually asks for: authentication that holds, payments that reconcile, reports that match the numbers, and deployments that do not fall over on a Monday morning.

Outside work I build the same way, end to end. ArenaHub is a turf booking platform I designed and shipped alone: PostgreSQL schema, .NET API, Google sign-in, Razorpay payments, Angular UI, deployed on Netlify and Render. Algo Trade streams broker market data over WebSocket into a live Angular dashboard. A cab booking platform runs on an Oracle Cloud VM I set up and maintain myself. BlazingAuth is a full authentication system built from scratch: JWT access tokens, refresh rotation, role-based access, email password reset.

How I work. I model the data before writing code, because what looks like an architecture problem is usually a schema problem. I build in working vertical slices, so there is always something runnable. And I verify instead of assuming: if I have not run it, hit the failure paths, and seen the output, it is not done.

I use AI coding agents daily and they make me genuinely faster. The judgment stays with me. Scope, review, and engineering decisions are mine to own, because AI is leverage, not a substitute for understanding.

I am open to full-time roles and freelance work, especially backend-heavy full-stack products where reliability matters. Email is the fastest way to reach me, and there is more detail on my portfolio: https://hrtalshania.github.io/portfolio/

profile.overview:
Full-stack .NET developer. I build web applications end to end: the database, the API, and the interface people actually use.

WHAT I BUILD

- Business web applications in ASP.NET Core with Blazor or Angular
- REST APIs with authentication, validation, and predictable error handling
- Databases in SQL Server and PostgreSQL: schema design, EF Core, query performance
- Payments and integrations: Razorpay, GoCardless, Azure Blob Storage, Cloudflare R2
- Authentication done properly: JWT access tokens, refresh rotation, role-based access, email password reset
- Deployment: Netlify, Render, Azure, and self-hosted Linux VMs
- Automated testing with Playwright, including screenshot capture for UI checks

HOW I WORK

1. I clarify what the feature should do before writing code.
2. I design the data model and API contracts first, because most architecture problems are schema problems.
3. I build in working vertical slices, so there is something runnable early.
4. I verify instead of assuming: run it, hit the failure paths, check the real output.
5. You get a working feature, not a half-finished layer.

RECENT WORK

ArenaHub - a sports venue booking platform I built and shipped alone. Map-based venue discovery, Google sign-in, slot booking, Razorpay payments, file uploads to Cloudflare R2, PostgreSQL with spatial queries. Live: https://staging-arenahub.netlify.app/

Algo Trade - a real-time trading dashboard. Python/FastAPI service consuming broker APIs and WebSocket market feeds, streamed into an Angular UI with live positions, orders, market depth and signal alerts. Live: https://algo-trade-by-hrt.netlify.app/

Cab Booking Platform - a booking platform with .NET APIs and an Angular front end that I self-host on an Oracle Cloud VM, including server setup, DNS, HTTPS and deployment. Live: https://ruhicabs.duckdns.org/

BACKGROUND

Software Engineer at Sky9 IT Craft (Rajkot, India) since 2024, across three client products: an aircraft ownership and flight-record platform, an enterprise mailing system used by US mailing organizations, and a UK waste-management admin platform. Blazor, SQL Server, Azure, RDLC reporting, GoCardless payments.

AVAILABILITY

Five days a week, 20-30 hours, replies within 24 hours. I work in IST (UTC+5:30) with overlap into EU and US mornings.

If you have a feature or a system that needs building properly, send me the scope and I will tell you honestly whether I am the right fit.

Portfolio and case studies: https://hrtalshania.github.io/portfolio/

Software engineer building complete systems: the database, the API, and the interface that uses them. Mostly C#, .NET, Angular, and Blazor.

---

## What I work on

- Full-stack web applications with ASP.NET Core and Angular or Blazor
- REST APIs with real authentication: JWT, refresh rotation, roles
- Database design in SQL Server and PostgreSQL
- Deployment and hosting: Netlify, Render, Azure, self-hosted Linux VMs

## Selected work

| Project | What it is | Stack |
|---|---|---|
| [ArenaHub](https://staging-arenahub.netlify.app/) | Sports venue booking platform, built and shipped solo | ASP.NET Core, Angular, PostgreSQL, Razorpay |
| [Algo Trade](https://algo-trade-by-hrt.netlify.app/) | Real-time market data dashboard | Python, FastAPI, WebSocket, Angular |
| [Cab Booking](https://ruhicabs.duckdns.org/) | Booking platform self-hosted on an Oracle VM | ASP.NET Core, Angular, Oracle Cloud |
| BlazingAuth | Authentication from scratch (code on request) | ASP.NET Core, JWT, SQL Server |

Case studies for each project: [portfolio](https://hrtalshania.github.io/portfolio/)

## How I work

- Model the data before writing code.
- Build in working vertical slices, never half-finished layers.
- Verify instead of assuming: if it has not been run and checked, it is not done.
- Use AI coding agents as leverage, with review and judgment kept on my side.

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/harshit-talshania/
